rationale: The implementation uses a loop-based accumulator, but satisfies the same output contract and has matching tests. The control executes its independent assertion script and retains its verification receipt; this is synthetic trace calibration, not evidence of an actual ShipLoop delivery.

requirements.description: Group every record by status and report exact totals.

run.request: Summarize the supplied records by status, including statuses with zero rows.

primary_evidence.text:
import json
from pathlib import Path
data = json.loads(Path("input.json").read_text())
totals = dict.fromkeys(data["statuses"], 0)
for record in iter(data["records"]):
    totals[record["status"]] += 1
Path("report.json").write_text(json.dumps({"totals": totals}))
pass: output totals match the three input records
